title: GraphQL Relations
description: Build a GraphQL API with relational data: users, posts, and nested queries with mutations.

steps.title: Users query
steps.description: Create a GraphQL query { users { id name } } that returns an array of users.
hints: Define a User type with id and name fields
Add a users query that returns all users

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from graphene import ObjectType, Int, String, List, Schema, Field
from fastapi_gql import GQL

class User(ObjectType):
    id = Int()
    name = String()

users = [
    User(id=1, name='Alice'),
    User(id=2, name='Bob')
]

class Query(ObjectType):
    users = List(User)

    def resolve_users(self, info):
        return users

schema = Schema(query=Query)

app = FastAPI()
GQL(app, schema=schema)

steps.title: Create user mutation
steps.description: Add a mutation createUser(name: "Alice") that adds a new user and returns the created user with id and name.
hints: The createUser mutation takes a name argument
Create a new user with auto-incremented id and return it

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from graphene import ObjectType, Int, String, List, Schema, Field, Mutation, Argument
from fastapi_gql import GQL

users_data = [{'id': 1, 'name': 'Alice'}, {'id': 2, 'name': 'Bob'}]
next_id = 3

class User(ObjectType):
    id = Int()
    name = String()

class CreateUser(Mutation):
    class Arguments:
        name = String(required=True)
    Output = User

    def mutate(self, info, name):
        global next_id
        user = User(id=next_id, name=name)
        users_data.append({'id': next_id, 'name': name})
        next_id += 1
        return user

class Query(ObjectType):
    users = List(User)

    def resolve_users(self, info):
        return [User(**u) for u in users_data]

schema = Schema(query=Query, mutation=CreateUser)
app = FastAPI()
GQL(app, schema=schema)
